title: Calcutta High Court asks State to clarify on status of proposal to entrust school mid-day meal to ISKCON
description: The Calcutta High Court on Wednesday sought details from the West Bengal government about the status of the proposal to handover preparation and supply of cooked meals under the mid-day meal scheme in Kolkata schools to International Society for Krishna Consciousness (ISKCON).A Division Bench of Acting Chief Justice Tapabrata Chakraborty and Justice Partha Sarathi Chatterjee asked the State to file an affidavit in this regard.
